Timeline not agreed

One conversation. The same pinned form. A useful disagreement.

See how calibration works →
THE OPPORTUNITY
Manual review should inform quality.
Not be the only way to see it.

Increase visibility across selected conversations, investigate the evidence, and use human judgment where it matters. Controlled coverage is a policy decision, not a claim of unlimited capacity.

WHY THIS APPROACH
Focused decisions. Transparent scoring. Human control.
Ask focused questions

Typed decisions evaluate specific criteria, with questions batched where their conditions permit.

Keep scoring in code

Weights, critical criteria and exact form versions make the score explainable.

Learn from disagreement

Human reviews preserve the original AI result and support calibration.

Typed answers can still be wrong. Confidence is not measured correctness; calibrate against human judgments. Confidence reference · checked 2026-10-03.

EXPLORE THE ECONOMICS
A small model bill. An honest starting point.

Browser-only planning estimates, not measured bills or total operating cost.

Conversation volume
Selected percentage
Advanced assumptions
ESTIMATED MODEL INPUT COST · USD
$33.60

100,000 selected conversations · 100,000 estimated form evaluations · 100,000 estimated AI requests.

Preset: 100,000 selected conversations × 1 form × 1 request × 8,000 input tokens. Two requests per form doubles the estimate to $67.20.

Average forms and requests can be fractional planning equivalents. Tokens include transcript and questions in each request; repeated transcript input across conditional waves counts again.

Official Jev 1.13 pricing: $0.042/M input tokens; output free. Checked 2026-10-03; rates may change.

Excluded: transcription, Genesys licensing/retrieval, Cloud Run/Firestore/network, retries, taxes and human review. Not a throughput commitment.

Start narrow. Calibrate. Decide with evidence.
Choose one queue and a representative, permissioned conversation set.
Agree criteria, weights and critical failures with quality reviewers.
Compare typed decisions with human judgments and investigate disagreement.
Measure retrieval, accuracy, cost and operational limits before expanding.

THE OPPORTUNITY
Manual review should inform quality.
Not be the only way to see it.

Increase visibility across selected conversations, investigate the evidence, and use human judgment where it matters. Controlled coverage is a policy decision, not a claim of unlimited capacity.

WHY THIS APPROACH
Focused decisions. Transparent scoring. Human control.
Ask focused questions

Typed decisions evaluate specific criteria, with questions batched where their conditions permit.

Keep scoring in code

Learn from disagreement

Average forms and requests can be fractional planning equivalents. Tokens include transcript and questions in each request; repeated transcript input across conditional waves counts again.
